now.E: Goood eeevening, island! This is Radio Coco, ninety-seven point threeee, and the night is young! Rico is not, but the night is!
now.M: Wakey wakey, White Rabbit Keeeey! Radio Coco, ninety-seven point threeee! The sun is up, the blocks are fresh, and Rico is LOUD!
now.P: Heeeeey, White Rabbit Keeeey! Radio Coco, ninety-seven point threeee! Out of the hammock, the island needs you!
now.N: Still uuuup, White Rabbit Keeeey? So is Radio Coco, ninety-seven point threeee! The chain never sleeps, and tonight neither does Rico!
now.A: Coco, coco, coco... RADIO COCOOOO! Ninety-seven point three, the loudest little station on any lagoon!

try.text: Gooood eeevening, island! Radio Coco, ninety-seven point threeee! The sun just clocked out, the blocks did not, and neither did I. Stay with me!
Eeeevening, everybody! Shoes off, sand in, volume UP! This is Rico on Radio Coco, ninety-seven point three, and the lagoon is glowing tonight!
Ohhh, there you are! Good evening, island! Radio Coco, ninety-seven point threeee! Grab something cold, the evening shift starts NOW!
Gooood morning, island! Radio Coco, ninety-seven point threeee! Coffee in one hand, keys in the other, let's GO!
Rise and shine, White Rabbit Keeeey! Rico's here, the sun's here, and a fresh block is on its way. Radio Coco, ninety-seven point three!
Morning, morning, MORNING! The roosters lost, Rico won! Radio Coco, ninety-seven point three, waking up the whole lagoon!
Heeeey, good afternoon, island! Radio Coco, ninety-seven point threeee! Lunch is done, the hammock is calling, and Rico says: not yet!
Afternoon, my people! It's hot, it's bright, it's Radio Coco, ninety-seven point three, and Rico has the fan on full!
Hello hello, sunny side of the day! Radio Coco, ninety-seven point threeee! Somebody poke the island, it's dozing off!
Still uuup? Me too! Radio Coco, ninety-seven point threeee, the night shift. Just us, the crabs, and one very busy validator.
Psst... night owls! Radio Coco, ninety-seven point three. Keep it low, keep it warm. The island's asleep, the blocks aren't.
Midnight on the island, and you're still here! I love you for that. Radio Coco, ninety-seven point threeee!
Turn it up, turn it UP! This is Radio Coco, ninety-seven point three, and Rico missed you!
Is this thing on? It IS! Radio Coco, ninety-seven point threeee, live from the lagoon, and Rico is in a GOOD mood!
Coco, coco, coco... RADIO COCOOOO! Ninety-seven point three! Hello, island, it's good to hear you!
